Types, brand representation and generic Clone call dispatch are preserved, not replaced by unconditional identity or panic models.
No new semantic axiom; exact axiom guards on all final maintained laws.
Generated modules compiled in isolated directories against the hash-bound prior expect-model standard-library overlay; no generated Lean or live .lake files edited.
Only the three declared production source files are directly hash-bound here; not a whole transitive-source fingerprint.
Full production Lean admission, library storage correspondence and candidate-stack adoption remain open.
Supporting proofs do not establish a second UnitDerivative relation, M1 completion or golden admission.
Exploratory unguarded axiom-census runs preceded the final guard edits and do not prove final-byte guard enforcement. Final authoritative runs are named above.

The initial composition-mutant diagnostic dropped an unused Clone member; an attempted start selector did not retain it. Those generated modules compiled but the whole law set was not run against them. The final copy-caller mutation preserves the six-entry, zero-opaque closure.
